note: The decision-cost register: for each open decision, what it costs to make, how it can be undone, the order it has to happen in, and the consequence of deciding nothing. Cost and risk are coarse reviewer estimates in time, labelled as estimates; they are not quotations and not program facts. 'consequence_of_waiting' is the part that usually decides it.

decisions.decision: Associates account, marketplace, tag and site ownership
decisions.cost: estimate: none in money; one sign-in and one copy of the tag
decisions.risk: estimate: none — no repository change follows until the tag exists
decisions.sequence: 1 — nothing downstream can be validated without it
decisions.blocks: every revenue, tracking and optimization item in the brief
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site remains a research desk. No click it generates can pay, and the optimization pages stay theoretical indefinitely.

decisions.decision: What to do with the three untagged link.amazon URLs
decisions.risk: estimate: low — the evidence pages must keep the original URL either way
decisions.blocks: reader-facing links on every product page
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: Readers click three links that cannot attribute a commission; the work of writing about the products earns nothing.

decisions.risk: estimate: very low — the sentence itself is already correct
decisions.sequence: 2 — independent of everything else, and cheap
decisions.blocks: nothing; improves compliance posture on 24 pages
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The single most load-bearing sentence in the programme stays at the bottom of the busiest pages, and the site keeps calling that adequate while its own ledger rule says otherwise.

decisions.decision: Keep or drop the pricing module
decisions.risk: estimate: none — price tracking is prohibited unless Amazon agrees in writing
decisions.blocks: the architecture of the optimization module
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: A module keeps being described in the platform documentation that the programme forbids by default (§3(y)); a future session could implement what a page already advertises.

decisions.effort: copy-only for A; one session plus hosting for B
decisions.cost: estimate: A free; B hosting cost only
decisions.risk: estimate: A none; B low if no visitor identifier is stored
decisions.sequence: 3 — after D-01, because a click without a tag cannot be reconciled to a commission
decisions.blocks: any optimization claim, any A/B test, any campaign reporting
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site keeps promising measurement it does not perform; the first performance figure anyone publishes will have no provenance.

decisions.cost: estimate: one session once access exists
decisions.risk: estimate: low — the ledger already models freshness and BLOCKED states
decisions.blocks: price display, ratings display, any automated refresh
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: Every specification stays manual and hand-dated, and the site can never update a product page without a human re-reading a manufacturer's page.

decisions.effort: minutes once an earnings report exists
decisions.risk: estimate: low, but a wrong rate misstates revenue to the owner
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The revenue model keeps showing bands rather than the owner's actual rate, which is honest but cannot answer 'what will this earn'.

decisions.cost: estimate: one mechanical pass plus a CI assertion
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: 150 links stay unqualified and the README keeps making a claim that is not true of the site.

decisions.risk: estimate: medium if an image is used without a corresponding Special Link — that is the licence condition
decisions.sequence: 4 — after D-01, because the licence condition references a Special Link
decisions.blocks: any imagery, any social preview card
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site stays text-only; every social share and every Discover impression has no image to show.

decisions.risk: estimate: none technical; reputational if the name is not real
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site asks readers to trust a page that does not say who wrote it — the exact shape Google's site-reputation example describes as likely to draw action.

decisions.cost: estimate: one session plus a sitemap rebuild
decisions.risk: estimate: medium — eight namespaces, each with its own gates and relative paths
decisions.reversible: yes — nothing is deleted, only relabelled
decisions.sequence: 3 — before any SEO work, because everything else depends on which pages exist
decisions.blocks: T-08, D-12, any canonical or sitemap work
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: Canonical tags and sitemaps would be built for a page set that is about to change; the duplicate-page signal keeps compounding.

decisions.effort: owner: buy or borrow the products
decisions.cost: estimate: the cost of the products, if purchased
decisions.reversible: no — you cannot un-buy a product, but the site can stay honest either way
decisions.blocks: any review, any rating, any 'best for' recommendation
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site stays a research desk. That is a legitimate product, but it is not the review site the brief describes, and the two are not the same business.

decisions.effort: free with Search Console, once a domain exists
decisions.risk: estimate: none if provenance is stated with each figure
decisions.sequence: 5 — last, because it needs traffic before it can be read
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: Topic selection stays editorial judgement. The site is honest about that, and it is also unable to say which topic is worth writing.

decisions.cost: estimate: one session per translation batch plus a language gate
decisions.risk: estimate: medium — a Japanese page needs a disclosure in Japanese and a marketplace check per ASIN
decisions.sequence: 2 — it changes the audience for every later decision
decisions.blocks: content plan, disclosure wording, marketplace choice
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: The site keeps writing English for an operator in Osaka, and every content decision stays provisional.

decisions.sequence: 1 — it determines whether any recommendation here is ever decided
decisions.consequence_of_waiting: Recommendations accumulate and none is chosen; sessions keep re-deriving the same review, which is exactly what happened across the 39 sessions before this one.
